If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact [[:Category:Administrators|one of us]] for more information! -- [[User:Mainphramephreak|Mainphramephreak]] ([[User_talk:Mainphramephreak|Talk]]) 20:20, June 18, 2010

== Quote template ==

Hello. First, thank you for adding all of that information to the chapter summary pages. It really is appreciated. On the {{tl|quote}} template, could you please include the attribution inside the template. Example: <nowiki>{{quote|Text goes here|Person goes here}}</nowiki>. Please let me know if you have any questions. Again, thanks for adding that info! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 17:07, May 16, 2012 (UTC)

== Redirects ==

Hello. Again, thanks for adding all of the info on the chapter summary pages. Also, thanks for adding some much-needed redirects. In the future, though, could you please add the appropriate category to the redirects? All of them can be found [[:Category:Redirects|here]]. Please let me know if you have any questions. Thanks again! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 02:02, August 20, 2012 (UTC)
